test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following care and maintenance of car air-conditioning is INCORRECT?

options.text: Vacuum the filter if it is dirty from driving in dusty or polluted areas.
Replace the cabin air filter regularly to prevent dust and pollen from clogging the system.
Perform electrical repairs to resolve issues with the electrical components of the AC unit
Do not replace the evaporator coil to prevent ice formation.

solution:
The correct answer is __Do not replace the evaporator coil to prevent ice formation.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vacuuming the filter__ helps remove dirt and dust accumulated from driving in polluted areas.
 
• Replacing the cabin air filter regularly prevents clogging and ensures efficient air circulation.
 
• Electrical repairs are essential to resolve issues within the AC unit and ensure proper functioning.
 
• Replacing the evaporator coil is necessary to maintain the cooling system and prevent ice formation.
 
• Proper maintenance enhances the performance and extends the lifespan of the air-conditioning unit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Regular Maintenance:**

 
 
• Regular maintenance ensures optimal performance and prevents costly repairs.
 
• It also improves air quality inside the vehicle.
 
 
 
• **Evaporator Coil:**
 
 
• The evaporator coil is crucial for cooling and dehumidifying the air.
 
• Neglecting its replacement can lead to ice formation and reduced efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Cabin Air Filter:**
 
 
• A clean cabin air filter ensures the removal of dust and allergens.
 
• Replacing it regularly enhances the comfort and health of passengers.
